op_hi: Modern Life vs. Life of Forefathers
q_hi:
Comprehension:
Read the following passage carefully and answer the questions based on it.

We are happier than our forefathers. Life is comfortable and worth living in the world of today. If our forefathers were to visit us today, they would be wonderstruck to notice the significant changes brought about by the advancement in science and technology. In the absence of medical facilities, our forefathers died premature deaths. Their movement was restricted, as there were no means of communication and conveyance. Being superstitious and illiterate, they believed that calamities happened as a result of the fury of gods. Today, with the advancement of science, we are leading a luxurious life and enjoying all the amenities like television, air-conditioners, refrigerators, etc., which are a gift of science. With the invention of fast-moving planes, the entire world has become easily accessible to us. Education has enabled man to think rationally so that he can easily solve any problem related to life. Medical science and hygienic conditions are helping him to enjoy a longer span of life. Thus, the man of today is definitely in a better position and is far happier than his forefathers.
What would be the most suitable title for the passage?
